objective: Test a portable gravity/tangent-aligned cross-section SDF compiler that can represent non-star-shaped real cave anatomy

representation.frame: gravity-aware local tangent frame; transported-frame upgrade required before final CW6 promotion
representation.longitudinal: nearest graph sample with 1.25 voxel tangent half-length cap

selection: Smallest DCT rank with mean equal-volume IoU >= 0.70 and no more than 0.02 below FULL_33; ties prefer lower coefficient count

gate.morphology: beats fitted single-radius sweep by 3-of-4 and negative mean-log distance on at least 4 of 5 whole-cave folds
gate.volume: zero-threshold median candidate/reference ratio in [0.8, 1.25] on at least 4 of 5 folds

promotion_limit: Passing this bake-off proves representation capacity only; stable transported frames, rotation invariance, seams, and CW5 validation remain required before CW6 closes
claim_limit: five burned development caves; target-derived compiler oracle only
